source_signature: Dulche.Prompt(port) and Dulche.Prompt() remain shorthand for an explicitly prepared request in the caller's scope. Add Dulche.PreparePrompt(prompt) to prepare caller-local input for those shorthand calls; consume a snapshot at submission and never reuse another caller's input. Without prepared input, return MissingPrompt. Explicit prompt/request overloads avoid hidden state and are preferred in concurrent code.
